description: STATE.json lives at <project root>/.paper/STATE.json and is resolved only by bin/lib/paths.ts (paperStateFile, plus legacyStateFile for the one-time pre-v1 move) and read or written only by bin/lib/state.ts (loadState / initState / saveState / updateState / readStateTextSync, which also run migrateLegacyLayout). No other shipped module builds a path from a bare 'STATE.json' segment: a second resolver is how the CLI once wrote the project root while the MCP server and hooks read .paper/. Everything else calls the state.ts API or paperStateFile(root).
